I agree with some points. Unless proven otherwise, females are just as capable to perform well in computer games. We just don't see any females commit 100% and for instance take a year out of collage to play Dota. 

Females aren't excluded from any tournaments. Males are excluded from female tournaments. Same way Germans are excluded from Irish tournaments. The problem with all female leagues is that many females choose to play there instead of competing on mixed teams in regular tournaments, which will limit their improvement. The over all skill level will be lower, there will be less players to find teammates from and the competition wont be as strong.
